'''Therah Yunin''' was [[Shalo Sherin]]'s [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] concubine. [[Gender/Legends|She]] followed Sherin everywhere, and felt that she owned him a debt for "something" he had done for her in the past.<ref name="LoNH" />
